Standard: Hydraulic pump pulsation (ripple) generated by high-speed rotating fluid equipment (e.g., engine driven pumps, electrically driven pumps, and ground cart pumps) does not induce resonant vibrations causing failure in the air vehicle system's tubing, components, and system supports (e.g., clamps and brackets) across the complete speed range (including start and stop), pressures, and flows of the pump IAW SAE AS5440B, Pump Pulsation paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct modeling or analysis to determine pump ripple frequencies and to verify they do not cause resonant frequencies or fatigue, resulting in failure of adjacent tubing and components. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct air vehicle representative HITL (e.g., iron bird) testing to verify pump ripple frequencies and to verify they do not cause resonant frequencies or fatigue, resulting in life reduction of adjacent tubing and components.
  (2) Ground test: Conduct on air vehicle testing to verify each approved ground cart’s pump ripple frequencies and to verify they do not cause resonant frequencies or fatigue, resulting in life reduction of adjacent tubing and components.
  (3) Ground test: Conduct on air vehicle testing to verify each air vehicle pump’s ripple frequency and to verify they do not cause resonant frequencies or fatigue, resulting in life reduction of adjacent tubing and components.
